## Games in Spotlight

- The PC's **Ready to Play** games now show up in the iPhone's search (swipe down on the Home Screen), with their cover. Tapping one opens Starlight on that game's page.
- The index follows the PC: hidden or removed games leave the search, and new games are added when the game list refreshes. Steam games that aren't installed aren't indexed.

## Feedback on Settings buttons that take a while

**Refresh Games** (PC), **Refresh Now** (Steam), **Download Missing Artwork** and **Re-download All Artwork** (Game Artwork) now show what's happening, all with system components:

- On tap the icon bounces and the iPhone gives a light haptic.
- While the work runs, the system spinner sits on the right and the button is disabled.
- When it finishes, the icon turns into a green ✓ for two seconds with a success haptic, or an orange warning with an error haptic if it failed. A PC refresh that takes more than 30 seconds counts as failed.

The search tab stays on every tab, as the system does it.
